title: phegopteris queenslandica
intro: Phegopteris queenslandica, commonly known as Queensland fern, is a plant species in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in traditional medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris queenslandica include its ability to treat conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
